title: President Sheinbaum Insists US Eliminate Tariffs on Cars, Steel & Aluminum
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Emir Olivares
content:

the[March 24, 2026 edition of

que-eu-elimine-o-baje-aranceles-para-autos-acero-y-aluminio)_[La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/03/24/economia/insiste-
sheinbaum-en-que-eu-elimine-o-baje-aranceles-para-autos-acero-y-aluminio) _,
Mexico 's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Mayor Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo reiterated her call for the
United States to eliminate or reduce tariffs on automobiles, steel, and
aluminum. She also stated that, like her administration, the U.S. government
is advocating for stronger rules of origin.

“The United States has publicly stated its intention to strengthen rules of
origin, as we have mentioned here, which means that if you are going to
produce an auto part, most of your components must also be manufactured in
Mexico, the United States, or Canada.”

President Sheinbaum said that lowering or eliminating tariffs "is part of the
discussion that is happening right now… and there is progress, but we still
don't see it reflected in the facts."

**They still haven 't accepted?**

"Yes, they accept it, but it's not yet reflected in reality, even though it's
already a fact."

**In the document?**

"Yes. There's a provision in the declarations made by the United States that
the component manufactured in the United States is deductible. Here, the
automakers told us that they were having difficulty obtaining that deduction
in the United States. And Secretary (Marcelo) Ebrard has requested this there,
and in that respect, for example, there has been more progress."
